rule_outs: Dwelling 3 m from the best section
summary: Tiny three-bay forecourt in inner-city West End, with a house 3 m away.
reasons: Detached dwelling 3 m from the bays

drivers.seclusion: Dense inner-city block: dwelling 3 m and 14 m away, apartment blocks within 20 to 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Three narrow bays between buildings, with cars in them; a van would overhang onto the footpath.
drivers.traffic: Quiet one-way-style street, but with a loading zone and no-stopping signs nearby.
drivers.convention: Business forecourt for the adjoining shops; Ferry Road loading zone Mon-Fri 7am-4pm, no stopping at other times.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.6 m elevation, 283 m from the Brisbane River
Signs: loading zone and no stopping at other times
sun_shade: Tall buildings shade it for much of the day; open to the sky only at midday from the north.
